sources.title: Kafka Java client 4.1.2: KafkaProducer
sources.supportRationale: Transactional producer lifecycle, error handling and coupling output with consumed positions; external effects are outside that atomic boundary.

sources.title: AWS Prescriptive Guidance: Transactional outbox
sources.supportRationale: Atomic local state/publication intent and remaining duplicate/consumer effect boundaries.

scenarios.theme: Audit and fraud each see only half the events. What is misconfigured?
scenarios.assumptions: Both independently require the complete stream but use one group ID. What will you do and why?
scenarios.limitations: Constructed production interview prompt; exact frequency, ranking and company attribution are unverified.

concept-specificity.rationale: Applies Consumer Groups to audit role.

distinctness.rationale: Separate constraint/decision: Audit and fraud each see only half the events. What is misconfigured?

production-prompt.rationale: Prompt states a production failure or workload bound and asks for a justified response.

direct-answer.rationale: Reviewed action: Give the applications independent group identities and plan a retained-history/snapshot bootstrap to recover missed input without repeating unsafe effects.

decision-costs.rationale: Reviewed cost/alternative: Independent groups add load and progress state

follow-up.rationale: Reviewed trap: Interchangeable replicas of the same role should still share work; do not create a group per worker accidentally.

evidence.rationale: Primary support mapped to kdesign, kapi; interview frequency is not claimed.

full-delivery.rationale: Three labeled parts are self-contained; native disclosure and host confidence integration use stable keys.

scenarios.theme: A worker pool finishes later offsets first. How do you commit safely?
scenarios.assumptions: A crash must recover all unfinished records in each partition. What will you do and why?
scenarios.limitations: Constructed production interview prompt; exact frequency, ranking and company attribution are unverified.

concept-specificity.rationale: Applies Consumer Groups to completion hole.

distinctness.rationale: Separate constraint/decision: A worker pool finishes later offsets first. How do you commit safely?

production-prompt.rationale: Prompt states a production failure or workload bound and asks for a justified response.

direct-answer.rationale: Reviewed action: Track durable completion per partition and commit only beyond the contiguous completed prefix, coordinating revocation and limiting outstanding work.

decision-costs.rationale: Reviewed cost/alternative: A slow earlier task can hold the checkpoint

follow-up.rationale: Reviewed trap: Serial processing simplifies bookkeeping; committing the largest finished offset trades correctness for apparent progress.

evidence.rationale: Primary support mapped to kapi; interview frequency is not claimed.
